title: 14x Speed Rush! OpenAI Launches GPT-5.6 Sol UltraFast Super Fast Mode, Up to 750 Tokens Per Second
excerpt: OpenAI has officially launched the new GPT-5.6Sol UltraFast super-fast mode preview for enterprise users. With this mode, the model's performance has seen a rev
content_html:
OpenAI has officially launched the new GPT-5.6Sol UltraFast super-fast mode preview for enterprise users. With this mode, the model's performance has seen a revolutionary improvement, reaching up to 14 times the speed of the standard mode, and can generate up to 750 tokens per second.

According to the information, the core technology of this ultra-fast mode is supported by Cerebras. However, in order to ensure the reasonable use of resources, this mode is currently available through an application review system. Enterprise users who need it must submit specific usage scenarios to OpenAI, and whether the application is approved will be comprehensively evaluated by the official based on actual circumstances.

In terms of application scenarios, OpenAI stated that the ultra-fast mode is not aimed at all regular workloads, but is specifically designed for business scenarios that require high real-time performance. For example: real-time voice interaction, intelligent customer support, business applications, development of intelligent agents (Agents), financial in-depth research, and cutting-edge security research.

As the preview phase progresses, the computing power provided by Cerebras will continue to be optimized. In the future, OpenAI plans to gradually expand the coverage based on feedback from enterprise workloads, allowing more enterprises to smoothly access this ultra-fast AI capability through the API interface.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI已正式为企业用户推出全新GPT-5.6Sol UltraFast超快模式预览版。 在该模式下，模型的性能得到了革命性的提升，速度最高可达标准模式的 14 倍，每秒最多可生成 750 个代币。

据了解，这种超快模式的核心技术得到了Cerebras的支持。 但为了保证资源的合理利用，目前这种模式可以通过申请审核系统来实现。 有需求的企业用户必须向OpenAI提交具体的使用场景，申请是否获得批准将由官方根据实际情况综合评估。

在应用场景方面，OpenAI表示，超快模式并非针对所有常规工作负载，而是专门针对实时性要求较高的业务场景而设计。 例如：实时语音交互、智能客户支持、业务应用、智能代理（Agents）开发、金融深入研究、前沿安全研究等。

随着预览阶段的进展，Cerebras 提供的算力将不断优化。 未来，OpenAI计划根据企业工作负载反馈逐步扩大覆盖范围，让更多企业通过API接口平滑接入这种超快的AI能力。
